core_obligations: Flatness observations (proof lines 7679-7682): the augmentation maps a_n and the simplicial maps d_i^n are flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective, by the P-covering remark.

QCoh(O_U) is a weak Serre subcategory (lines 7684-7698): quasi-coherence on U is cartesian plus quasi-coherent components; cartesian modules are weak Serre (with flat d_i^n), and QCoh(O_{U_n}) is weak Serre in Mod(O_{U_n}) for every n (Properties of Spaces); the combination gives the claim.

Conditions (1)-(5) of the unbounded criterion (lines 7700-7763): (1) a is flat by the flatness of the a_n via the flat-augmentation lemma; (2) and (3) are exactly the statements of the dedicated descent lemmas of this chapter; (4) take B = the affine objects, Cov = etale coverings by affines and d = 0 - the sanity-check lemma reduces H^p(V/U_n, F) to H^p(V, F_n), which vanishes for p > 0 on affines (Cohomology of Spaces discussion + Cohomology of Schemes lemma); (5) the same choice of B for X.
proof_roadmap: Observe flatness of the augmentation and simplicial maps; conclude QCoh(O_U) is weak Serre.
Verify the five conditions of the Cohomology-on-Sites unbounded criterion, citing the two dedicated descent lemmas for (2) and (3).
Set up the affine-object vanishing for conditions (4) and (5).
